name_reason: Name is already compliant with the global naming convention (data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>, battle core scalar -> data_fd2_battle_*). Descriptor 'player_action_result_code' accurately reflects use: a 4-byte int result/sentinel for the player-turn action menu. No Ghidra address residue in the name; no domain ID to preserve.
purpose: Player-turn action outcome flag/sentinel: signals whether the current player unit's turn-action UI committed an action (advance turn) or was cancelled (re-prompt).
logic_summary: Runtime battle-state scalar, zero-initialized in the image (.object2 BSS, all bytes 0). fd2_player_action_menu_loop stores 0 to it at entry and later returns it as the function's int result; fd2_item_command_menu_dispatch stores 1 to it when a GIVE command actually transfers an item (so even if the inline action menu returns -1/cancel, the outer loop sees non-zero and treats the turn as committed). fd2_player_action_menu_loop reads it back (full dword MOV EAX,[0x53C53]) and compares against 0 (CMP [0x53C53],0) on several re-prompt branches: still 0 after a cancel -> return 0 (re-prompt); non-zero -> action committed, advance turn.
datatype: undefined4 (4-byte int; accessed as full dword)
element_semantics: Single scalar result code: 0 = cancelled / no commit -> re-prompt; non-zero (set to 1 by committed GIVE) = action committed -> advance turn.
